label: Fudge
note: Softer than caramel and firmer than fondant. Modern fudge comes from 19th century USA; Cornish fudge uses clotted cream instead of milk, and the Scottish tablet is grainier and brittle.

about.text: A soft confection of sugar, butter and milk, beaten as it cools so the sugar forms fine crystals.
